queries.item: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ab__ia_data` ( `product_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `join_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `timestamp` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `list` text NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`product_id`,`join_id`) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ab__ia_joins` ( `join_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `base_category_id` int(11) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `joined_category_id` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `price_from` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0.00', `price_to` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00', `shuffle_products` char(1) DEFAULT 'N', `only_in_stock` char(1) DEFAULT 'N', `products_sorting` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'null-asc', `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `position` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `max_view_products` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '20', `last_update_date` TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, `tab_url` varchar(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_use', `custom_url` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT '', `start_update` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `end_update` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', PRIMARY KEY (`join_id`) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ab__ia_join_descriptions` ( `join_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `lang_code` char(2) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (`join_id`,`lang_code`), KEY `join_id` (`join_id`) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `?:ab__ia_rules` ( `rule_id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, `join_id` int(11) NOT NULL, `name` varchar(255) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'no-name', `conditions` text NOT NULL, `status` char(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'A', `position` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0', `max_view_products` tinyint(3) unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '20', PRIMARY KEY (`rule_id`) ) DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
